aboutGame.title: What is Digimon World Definitive Edition?
paragraphs: Digimon World Definitive Edition is a fan-made project in development to modernize and expand the classic Digimon World experience. Community reporting credited IAnime Studios with the project, and the developers share updates through its Discord server. This wiki also makes the distinction clear: it is not an official Bandai Namco release.

Announced plans include 16:9 widescreen support, new Digimon, new evolution routes, new attacks, new maps, and three language options. Digimon World Definitive Edition Wiki organizes the project's status and context so fans can separate confirmed information from speculation.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Digimon World Definitive Edition.

items.question: What is Digimon World Definitive Edition?
items.answer: Digimon World Definitive Edition is a fan project in development to modernize and expand the original Digimon World. Community reporting credited IAnime Studios, and announced plans include widescreen support, new Digimon, new evolution routes, new attacks, new maps, and three language options.

items.question: Is Digimon World Definitive Edition an official Bandai Namco release?
items.answer: No. It is a community project, and this wiki is an independent fan guide. Bandai Namco has not announced an official remaster of the original Digimon World.

items.question: When does Digimon World Definitive Edition release?
items.answer: No release date or window has been announced. No playable demo or download has been announced either; development updates are shared through the project's Discord server.

items.question: What improvements does Digimon World Definitive Edition include?
items.answer: The developers announced 16:9 widescreen support, new Digimon, new evolution routes, new attacks, new maps, and three language options. These are project plans rather than confirmed mechanics from a released build.

items.question: How can I follow Digimon World Definitive Edition?
items.answer: Follow IAnime Studios on YouTube, join the project's Discord server, and monitor community coverage such as Digimon Fans Chile for milestone updates.
